primary_title: Cloning and characterization of a novel ADP receptor; ADP receptor P2Y12 mediates ADP-induced inhibition of platelet adenylyl cyclase
decision_basis: ADP activates cloned/transfected P2Y12/P2RY12 with receptor binding, Gi-dependent adenylyl-cyclase inhibition and platelet aggregation support
limitations_preserved: Preserve P2Y12 versus P2Y1 distinction and the two-receptor requirement for full platelet aggregation; no SCI inference.

primary_title: Molecular cloning and characterization of a novel UDP-glucose receptor, a member of the P2Y purinoceptor family
decision_basis: UDP-glucose activates the cloned human P2Y14/P2RY14 receptor in heterologous systems with nucleotide-sugar specificity
limitations_preserved: Preserve UDP-glucose/nucleotide-sugar ligand specificity and heterologous assay limits; no SCI inference.

primary_title: Molecular cloning and characterization of a novel prostaglandin receptor for prostaglandin D2
decision_basis: PGD2 activates CRTH2/PTGDR2 in receptor-expression systems and primary human Th2/eosinophil/basophil chemotaxis assays
limitations_preserved: Keep CRTH2/PTGDR2 distinct from the existing PGD2-to-DP1/PTGDR1 edge; preserve leukocyte chemotaxis context and no SCI inference.

primary_title: Cloning and expression of a human galanin receptor
decision_basis: Galanin binds the cloned human GALR1 and inhibits adenylyl cyclase in transfected cells
limitations_preserved: Preserve recombinant human receptor and Gi-linked assay context; no SCI inference.

primary_title: A second galanin receptor subtype in human and rat; Galanin receptor 2 expression and signaling
decision_basis: Galanin activates GALR2 in receptor-expressing systems with cAMP inhibition, PLC activation and calcium mobilization
limitations_preserved: Preserve species- and assay-dependent coupling; do not generalize one G-protein route or infer SCI.

primary_title: Adenosine receptors in human hippocampus: cloning and expression of the A2b subtype
decision_basis: Adenosine activates cloned human A2B/ADORA2B in CHO cells with cAMP elevation at high agonist concentrations
limitations_preserved: Preserve the low-affinity A2B subtype and high-adenosine/heterologous-cell context; no SCI inference.

primary_title: Molecular cloning of a human C5a receptor; expression and functional characterization of the C5a receptor
decision_basis: C5a binds the cloned human C5AR1/CD88 receptor and activates calcium signaling in C5a-receptor expression systems
limitations_preserved: Keep human binding and canine functional evidence explicitly separated; distinguish C5AR1 from C5AR2 and no SCI inference.

primary_title: Species-selective binding of complement C8 to CD59
decision_basis: C8alpha/C8A interacts with CD59 during C5b-8/MAC assembly and CD59-dependent hemolysis inhibition
limitations_preserved: Preserve nascent C5b-8/MAC assembly and species-selective C8alpha recognition; no soluble-free C8 equivalence or intracellular relay.

primary_title: CD59 inhibits the formation of human membrane attack complex by binding to C8 and C9
decision_basis: C9 fragments interact with CD59 during membrane-attack-complex assembly in affinity and antibody-blocking assays
limitations_preserved: Preserve nascent C9/MAC assembly and fragment-assay context; do not infer binding to soluble native C9 or intracellular signaling.

primary_title: C3a receptors on human neutrophils and monocytes
decision_basis: C3a binds C3AR1/C3aR on human U937 and neutrophil systems and triggers calcium mobilization
limitations_preserved: Preserve human-cell context and C3a form; no CNS/SCI branch inference.

primary_title: C5a receptor 2 is a decoy receptor that attenuates C5a-induced inflammation
decision_basis: C5a and C5a-desArg activate C5AR2/C5L2-associated beta-arrestin2 redistribution and receptor internalization in heterologous systems
limitations_preserved: Represent atypical arrestin-coupled activation and internalization; do not claim canonical G-protein signaling or SCI effects.

primary_title: Protease-activated receptor 2 mediates factor Xa-induced endothelial cell activation
decision_basis: Factor Xa activates PAR2/F2RL1 in endothelial systems with phosphoinositide hydrolysis and ERK1/2 phosphorylation, with PAR1 contribution in some contexts
limitations_preserved: Preserve proteolytic PAR2 activation and endothelial/coagulation-protease topology; PAR1 contributes in some settings and no SCI inference is made.

review_locator: Annual Reviews LDLR structure/function review, LDL receptor cytoplasmic sorting section
primary_title: The autosomal recessive hypercholesterolemia protein interacts with the LDL receptor and mediates endocytosis
decision_basis: LDLR NPVY motif binds the ARH/LDLRAP1 PTB domain and supports clathrin/AP2-associated endocytic sorting
limitations_preserved: Keep LDLR NPVY and endocytic-adaptor context distinct from LRP2 identities; no receptor signaling claim.

primary_title: The cytoplasmic domain of RAGE binds to the formin mDia1 and regulates cell migration
decision_basis: RAGE cytoplasmic tail associates with DIAPH1/mDia1 and supports ligand-stimulated Rac1/Cdc42 and migration responses
limitations_preserved: Preserve cytoplasmic effector association and actin/migration context; RAGE ligand identity is not unique and no SCI/terminal-TF inference is made.

primary_title: Phosphatidylinositol phosphates are recognized by CD14 and contribute to apoptotic cell clearance
decision_basis: Externalized phosphatidylinositides are recognized by CD14 and contribute to apoptotic-cell clearance in CD14-dependent phagocyte assays
limitations_preserved: Preserve PIP versus phosphatidylserine distinction and GPI-anchored CD14 lack of intracellular tail; no kinase relay or SCI inference.
